question:
From the given options, replace the (?) with the option that represents some relationship between the alphabets given in the image?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ca1a38c4d292a1e1da5f75c20bc45ffb1f7758635b5d0e062a055e1d89de440.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The sum of the positional value of the two opposite end letters = middle missing letter (?)**

 
• Positional value of **Y = 25**
 
• Positional value of **A = 1**
 
• Positional value of **P = 16**
 
• Positional value of **J = 10**
 
• Positional value of **E = 5**
 
• Positional value of **U = 21**

⇒ ?
